name: Benzhydrocodone
summary: Benzhydrocodone (INN; contracted from benzoate-hydrocodone) is an opioid prodrug of the morphinan class. Its chemical structure consists of hydrocodone coupled with benzoic acid. Benzhydrocodone itself is inactive and acts as a prodrug to hydrocodone upon cleavage of the benzoate portion of the molecule.

pharmacology.text: Benzhydrocodone (INN; contracted from benzoate-hydrocodone) is an opioid prodrug of the morphinan class. Benzhydrocodone itself is inactive and acts as a prodrug to hydrocodone upon cleavage of the benzoate portion of the molecule.

uses.text: It is designed to be an opioid analgesic with a low chance of recreational use. When approved, Apadaz received a labeling that highlighted all relevant aspects of the drug, including the lower abuse profile compared to traditional hydrocodone-acetaminophen.

sideEffects.en: Because it releases hydrocodone, its effects are those of hydrocodone: drowsiness, nausea, constipation, itching and slowed breathing. Overdose can be fatal, and regular use leads to tolerance and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 由於它會釋出氫可酮，其反應就是氫可酮的反應：嗜睡、噁心、便祕、搔癢與呼吸變慢。過量可能致命，規律使用會導致耐受性與依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于它会发布氢可酮，其反应就是氢可酮的反应：嗜睡、恶心、便秘、搔痒与呼吸变慢。过量可能致命，规律使用会导致耐受性与依赖。

fact.en: Its name is a contraction of benzoate and hydrocodone, which is exactly what it is. It is inactive until the body cuts off the benzoate, an idea meant to make it harder to misuse by snorting or injecting.
fact.zh: 它的名稱是 benzoate 與 hydrocodone 的縮合，字面上就是它的組成。它在身體切下苯甲酸之前沒有活性，這個設計的目的是讓它較難透過鼻吸或注射濫用。
fact.zhHans: 它的名称是 benzoate 与 hydrocodone 的缩合，字面上就是它的组成。它在身体切下苯甲酸之前没有活性，这个设计的目的是让它较难通过鼻吸或注射滥用。
